result.title: Ori: Drift-Aware Streaming $k$-PCA for Very Low-Rank LLM Training
result.summary: A prominent family of low-rank LLM optimizers, pioneered by GaLore, performs gradient-subspace projection: at each step, they project the gradient into a low-dimensional subspace and map the update back to the full model. Most existing work either recomputes the gradient subspace at certain intervals, or performs post-hoc adaptation to catch up to the moving subspace. In this work, we explicitly identify in practice the slow, stable manner in which LLM gradient subspaces drift across time. To this end, we propose Ori, a novel low-rank optimizer for training LLMs that captures the shifting principal gradient directions over time to achieve state-of-the-art accuracy under stringent low-rank constraints. Ori employs a streaming $k$-PCA algorithm inspired by Oja++, whose low per-step cost enables high-frequency, on-the-fly subspace tracking. In practice, Ori reduces the performance gap of the state-of-the-art low-rank optimizers to full-rank optimizers by up to 69.3\% on a 1B LLaMA pretraining task, and achieves the best performance on 10 out of 16 task scenarios in Roberta-Base fine-tuning. Together, these contributions allow Ori to further push the performance and efficiency frontiers of gradient-projecting optimizers, narrowing the gap to full-rank training for LLMs. Code can be found at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Ori-Submission-2132.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Ori，一种漂移感知的流式 k-PCA 低秩优化器：针对 LLM 梯度子空间随时间缓慢漂移的现象，用受 Oja++ 启发、单步开销很低的在线算法高频跟踪主方向，在严格低秩约束下缩小与全秩训练的差距（1B LLaMA 预训练等）。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「低单步成本、高频在线跟踪漂移主子空间」的机制，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理状态或缓存子空间的低成本增量更新与漂移适应提供可核查线索；但论文本身面向梯度投影优化，与视觉多模态推理无直接联系。
